design.hazard: finishing with a derived result that was never checked against the workspace's provided verification runner
design.enforcement_plane: session-end verification obligation (--verification-final-gate); non-gate cells run --verification-final-observe so the outcome record exists symmetrically in every cell

primary_metric_definition: task_success (byte-exact workspace grade) AND verification_obligation_met (a successful verification followed the last realized mutation)

anti_contamination.statement: All cases are self-authored synthetic derive-then-verify tasks with machine-computed expected values; no benchmark task content, rubric, or test material appears in any rule, memory text, or prompt. The gate and memory texts are task-agnostic process guidance.

claim_boundary: internal complete 2x2 attribution for the verification-obligation family; not external benchmark superiority
